old_findings.note: DstConfigSet's data is still a raw memory range filled by the validating copy loop. Its length is now printed worse (see the regression).

regressions.decompiled: _3 = mem[64] ... log 0xf7b6cda3...: mem[mem[64] len _3 + 64 * cd[_param1 + 4] - mem[64] + 64]
regressions.issue: A new variable _3 holds mem[64], and the log length keeps _3 - mem[64] unfolded although no store to mem[64] lies between. Round 1 printed 64 * len + 64.
regressions.rule: x = mem[64] with no store to mem[64] in between gives x - mem[64] = 0; do not introduce such a variable when its only use cancels.

improvements: The parameters of getFee/getFeeOnSend (unknowncbe56fcc, unknown7e034df8) are named after their calldata word: _param1, _param4, _param5..._param8. This shows that words 2-3 of the 8-word head are never read, and the renaming is consistent in both bodies.
notes: Diff of 200 lines, read in full. Apart from the log length in setDstConfig, every change in the two fee functions is the parameter renaming (each body checked: requires, the router static call's arguments, the uint16 multiplier default). The source loop and the 3 implicit validating copies are unchanged.
summary: One low regression: the DstConfigSet log length now carries an unfolded _3 - mem[64]. Unknown-function parameters are renamed by calldata position, consistently.
